mapper.sql: t.id, t.club_id, t.user_id, t.role, t.join_date, t.quit_date, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS student_no, COALESCE(sp.class_name, u.class_name) AS class_name, c.club_name AS club_name

FROM club_member t LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = t.user_id AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN club c ON c.id = t.club_id AND c.deleted = 0
